title: Staging Remote Runtime catalog read-only privileges

phases.objective: Restore only SELECT privileges in Staging for Remote Runtime catalog and Hostinger allowlist discovery without changing Production bootstrap roles or broadening database authority.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Exact Staging runtime grant contract and its generated plan include exactly SELECT for both Remote Runtime tables, while Production/bootstrap plans remain unchanged. Live grant application and runtime readback require a separate Staging-only operator action.
steps: Confirm the runtime app executes catalog queries using DB_USER/getPool() against growth_runtime on isolated Staging.
Include remote_runtime_targets and remote_runtime_command_allowlists in STAGING_RUNTIME_READ_ONLY_TABLES only.
Verify table operations are strictly SELECT and required in the generated Staging runtime grant plan.
Reject Production/bootstrap role expansion, GRANT OPTION, schema-wide privileges, credential output and cross-environment operations.
Keep the existing exact-main global repair flow separate from this unmerged PR-head patch; do not use REVOKE ALL to repair these two tables.
After independent Staging approval and table/identity preflight, require two exact table-level GRANT SELECT changes with same-cycle runtime identity/readback.
assertions: Staging grants include both Remote Runtime catalog tables once each with SELECT only.
Staging Remote Runtime discovery must not require any runtime INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, schema-wide GRANT, GRANT OPTION, or arbitrary shell authority.
No Hostinger provider, Production host, Cloudflare or database mutation is executed by this source-only change.
CI test outcome is not evidence of live Staging MariaDB privilege repair.

phases.objective: Do not grant or modify Production role privileges as part of this isolated Staging remediation.
blockers: Production bootstrap grant contracts remain unchanged.
Production runtime and deploy need independently approved governance and attested readback.
